title: 第二十一章你认真的？
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
任务台前安静了一瞬。

    紧接着，后面那群外门弟子直接炸了。

    “啥玩意儿？我没听错吧？”

    “锻体四阶，接血色悬赏？”

    “兄弟，你是不是昨天练功把脑子练岔了？”

    “别闹了，这地方不是杂役院，乱接任务真会死人的！”

    叶凡没回头。

    他把令牌按在桌上，手指轻轻敲了敲。

    负责登记的执事弟子坐在木桌后，原本还低头翻册子，这会儿终于抬起脸。

    那人二十七八岁的模样，穿着外门执事服，修为在锻体九阶上下，脸上写满了不耐烦。

    他先看了叶凡一眼，又扫向后面那块血色木牌。

    “你确定？”

    叶凡点头。

    “确定。”

    执事弟子皱了皱眉，把令牌拿起来，翻到背面看了一眼。

    “叶凡。”

    他念出名字时停了一下。

    似乎觉得这个名字有些耳熟，但一时没想起来。

    叶凡安安静静站着。

    后面那些弟子已经笑开了。

    瘦高弟子挤到最前面，抱着胳膊，跟看猴似的看着叶凡。

    “兄弟，差不多得了。”

    “你刚才在人堆里装装样子，大家笑两声也就过去了。”

    “真把令牌拍上去，那就不是开玩笑了。”

    旁边络腮胡也乐了。

    “我估摸着，这小子八成是想出名。”

    “接了任务，满大厅的人都记住他了。”

    “等三天后回来，随便说一句没抓到，那不就完事了？”

    这话一出，众人立刻反应过来。

    “有道理啊！”

    “靠，原来是打这个算盘。”

    “接任务又不是马上去送死，先把名声混起来。”

    “锻体四阶抢血色悬赏，明天外门茶摊都得聊他。”

    “这活儿真聪明，脸皮够厚就行。”

    笑声一阵接一阵。

    还有人故意提高嗓门。

    “师弟，回头记得跟我们讲讲，雷劫地的鸡毛长啥样！”

    “别讲鸡毛了，他估计连雷劫地的边都摸不着。”

    “你们不懂，人家接的是气势，抓不抓鸡另说。”

    任务大厅里不少人都看了过来。

    有人摇头，有人哄笑，也有人懒得搭理。

    这种想露脸的新人，每年都有。

    只不过像叶凡这么敢玩的，确实少见。

    执事弟子把令牌放在桌上，手掌按住，语气沉了些。

    “听清楚。”

    “白色牌子的基础任务，失败了，大多扣点贡献，或者重新派杂活。”

    “血色悬赏不一样。”

    他伸手点了点桌面。

    “接下之后，三日内不交任务，罚十块下品灵石。”

    “交不出灵石，就去矿脉服役三个月。”

    “若是故意接任务扰乱大厅秩序，按宗规再罚三十鞭。”

    “你一个锻体四阶，拿得出十块灵石？”

    后面顿时又热闹了。

    “十块灵石？这小子怕是连一块都掏不出来吧？”

    “矿脉三个月，那可比废阁还难受。”

    “哈哈哈，这回露脸露大了。”

    瘦高弟子笑得直拍旁边人的肩膀。

    “叶师弟，听见没？现在后悔还来得及。”

    “你跟执事师兄认个错，就说自己刚才手滑，令牌不小心拍上去了。”

    “大家顶多笑你半个月，不会笑你一年。”
content_en:
There was silence in front of the task table for a moment.

    Immediately afterwards, the group of outer disciples behind them exploded.

    "What the hell? Did I hear correctly?"

    "Fourth level of body training, accepting a bloody bounty?"

    "Brother, did you have a mental disorder from practicing yesterday?"

    "Stop making trouble, this place is not a mess hall. Taking tasks randomly will really kill people!"

    Ye Fan didn't look back.

    He pressed the token on the table and tapped it lightly with his fingers.

    The deacon disciple in charge of registration was sitting behind the wooden table. He had lowered his head to flip through the book, but now he finally raised his face.

    The man was in his mid-twenties, wearing an outer deacon's uniform. His cultivation level was around the ninth level of physical training. His face was full of impatience.

    He glanced at Ye Fan first, and then glanced at the bloody wooden sign behind him.

    "Are you sure?"

    Ye Fan nodded.

    "OK."

    The deacon disciple frowned, picked up the token, turned to the back and took a look.

    "Ye Fan."

    He paused as he read the name.

    The name seemed familiar, but I couldn't remember it for a moment.

    Ye Fan stood quietly.

    The disciples behind him were already laughing.

    The tall and thin disciple squeezed to the front, folded his arms, and looked at Mark like a monkey.

    "Brother, it's almost done."

    "You were just showing off in the crowd, and everyone just laughed and passed away."

    "If you really take a picture of the token, it won't be a joke."

    The bearded man next to him was also happy.

    "I estimate that this kid probably wants to be famous."

    "After taking over the task, everyone in the hall will remember him."

    "When you come back in three days, if you just say something and you haven't been caught, then won't that be the end of it?"

    As soon as these words came out, everyone reacted immediately.

    "It makes sense!"

    "Damn, it turned out to be this plan."

    "It's not like you're going to die right away when you accept a mission. You need to build up your reputation first."

    "There's a bounty for grabbing the Bloody Level 4 Bodybuilder. We'll have to talk about him at the outer tea stalls tomorrow."

    "This is a really smart job. You just need to be thick-skinned."

    The laughter came one after another.

    Others deliberately raised their voices.

    "Junior brother, remember to tell us later what the chicken feathers in Lei Jie Land look like!"

    "Don't talk nonsense, he probably can't even touch the edge of Thunder Tribulation Land."

    "You don't understand. What people receive is momentum. Whether they catch the chicken or not is another matter."

    Many people in the mission hall looked over.

    Some shook their heads, some laughed, and some were too lazy to pay attention.

    There are new people like this who want to show up every year.

    It's just that it's really rare for people like Ye Fan to dare to play.

    The deacon disciple placed the token on the table, held it down with his palm, and spoke in a deeper tone.

    "Listen clearly."

    "If the basic tasks of the white brand fail, most of them will have their contribution points deducted, or they will be assigned chores again."

    "The blood bounty is different."

    He reached out and tapped the table.

    "After accepting it, if you don't turn in the task within three days, you will be fined ten pieces of low-grade spiritual stones."

    "If you can't hand over the spirit stone, you will serve in the mines for three months."

    "If you deliberately accept a mission to disrupt order in the hall, you will be punished with an additional thirty lashes according to the sect's rules."

    "How can you get ten spiritual stones from a fourth-level body training?"

    It suddenly became lively again.

    "Ten spiritual stones? I'm afraid this kid can't even take out one, right?"

    "Three months of mining, that's worse than the abandoned pavilion."

    "Hahaha, I'm showing off my face this time."

    The tall and thin disciple laughed so hard that he slapped the person next to him on the shoulder.

    "Junior Brother Ye, do you hear me? It's not too late to regret now."

    "Admit your mistake to Senior Brother Deacon and say that your hand slipped just now and the token was accidentally slapped on."

    "Everyone will laugh at you for half a month at most, but not for a year."
